youtube.title: Imagine You Were an NPC in GTA 6 for One Day #Shorts
youtube.description:
Imagine you were an NPC in GTA 6 for one day. No missions, no heists, just a normal life in the background. Remy lives one average American day, slice by slice.

Sleep: Americans aged 15 and over sleep about 9 hours a day (9.04 h, naps included).
Commute: the average one-way trip to work in the US takes about 27 minutes (26.8 min).
Work: on days they work, employed people put in about 7.5 hours (7.60 h).
Chores: about 2 hours a day go to household activities like cooking and cleaning (2.01 h).
Free time: about 5 hours of leisure a day (5.07 h), and the biggest part of it is watching TV, about 2.6 hours.

That's the real NPC loop: sleep, commute, work, chores, screen, repeat. Meanwhile the main character drives past at full speed. But here's the twist: to the people around you, you're the main character. In the game, NPCs follow a script. In real life, you can change yours any day.
What's one thing you'd change in your daily loop?

Note: the 24-hour ring in the video is an illustration of separate survey averages (different groups of people), not one person's diary.

Sources:
- BLS American Time Use Survey 2024 results (population 15+, average per day: sleeping 9.04 h; employed persons on days worked 7.60 h; household activities 2.01 h; leisure and sports 5.07 h): https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/atus_06262025.htm
- BLS, Time spent in leisure and sports in 2024 (watching TV 2.6 h, the largest leisure activity): https://www.bls.gov/opub/ted/2025/time-spent-in-leisure-and-sports-in-2024.htm
- Mean one-way travel time to work 26.8 minutes (ACS 2023 1-year, Census data via NAHB): https://eyeonhousing.org/2024/10/travel-time-to-work-across-congressional-districts/ , https://www.census.gov/topics/employment/commuting/guidance/acs-1yr.html

Remy is fictional. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two. No game footage, art or logos are used.
AI disclosure: made with AI assistance (script drafting, animation). Narration: AI voice (Google AI Studio, Gemini TTS).
